summary.headline: Cancer and Virgo Birth Prognostications
summary.text: Astrological physiognomic and prognostic descriptions for people born under Cancer and Virgo, covering illnesses, character, marriage, livelihood, longevity, and prescribed liturgies to the honorable Cross and Saint Anna for healing.
